mapper.delete: DELETE FROM Wishlist WHERE member_id = #{memberId} and scene_id = #{sceneId}
mapper.select: SELECT d.drama_id as dramaId, d.title as title, d.released_at as releasedAt, d.description as description, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Scene all_s WHERE all_s.drama_id = d.drama_id) as sceneCount FROM WISHLIST w join Scene s on w.scene_id = s.scene_id join Drama d on s.drama_id = d.drama_id WHERE w.member_id = #{memberId} GROUP BY d.drama_id ORDER BY MAX(w.created_at) DESC

SELECT w.wishlist_id as wishlistId, w.scene_id as sceneId, s.name as name, s.description as description, s.address as address, s.latitude as latitude, s.longitude as longitude, w.created_at as createdAt FROM Wishlist w join Scene s on w.scene_id = s.scene_id WHERE w.member_id = #{memberId} and s.drama_id = #{dramaId} ORDER BY w.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WISHLIST( member_id, scene_id ) VALUES(#{memberId}, #{sceneId})
